title: Beyond the training inventory: transferability and independent validation of national machine-learning flood susceptibility maps for Slovenia: code
description: Python pipeline (data preparation, model training, spatial cross-validation, transferability tests, verification at the true base rate, validation against civil-protection flood reports, figures and tables) for the article 'Beyond the training inventory: transferability and independent validation of national machine-learning flood susceptibility maps for Slovenia' (Arora and Petan, submitted to the Journal of Hydrology). The maps and model inputs are in a separate Zenodo data deposit.
